bold.$description: Bold emphasis in the entry text.

root.$description: The root font size = the entry text size (1rem). All font sizes, spacing, radii, row heights and icon sizes are set in rem, so changing this size changes the whole density, not only the text.

default.$description: Entry text size 13 px: chosen by the user on 20.10.2026 on a live screen among 13 / 14 / 15 px (ADR-0004). The px values in token descriptions are at this root.

scale.$description: Text scale: a multiplier of the root font size on top of font.root. Switched by the data-text-scale attribute on the root element (see base.css).
